mentions.name: Metner
mentions.description: A web platform that gives micro-preneurs (people with side-hustles) a dedicated web presence for growing businesses focused on local communities, aiming to move them off relying on Facebook/Instagram groups and help them earn money from their hobbies.
mentions.problem: Side-hustlers lack a dedicated web presence and currently rely on Facebook/Instagram groups to reach local communities.
mentions.audience: micro-preneurs (people with side-hustles), and people who want to make some beer/coffee money off of their hobbies
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://metner.app to give micro-preneurs (people with side-hustles) a dedicated web presence to grow businesses focused on local communities.

Goal is to help people move off of relying on Facebook/Instagram groups. And to support people who want to make some beer/coffee money off of their hobbies.
mentions.author: gavino
